overclaims: The original OpenAI quarterly report could not be read.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, conditions, axis and outcome are all correct, and so is the e1 citation. One limitation gets its source wrong. The page that could not be read (HTTP 403) was The Information's article on OpenAI's first quarter of 2026. It was not a quarterly report issued by OpenAI, but 'The original OpenAI quarterly report' suggests a company filing exists. Suggested wording: 'The Information's report on OpenAI's Q1 2026 finances could not be read.'

The proposition keeps all five companies and 'entirely speculative'. The rationale matches the evidence: e1 ties sales to AI products (HBM, server DRAM, eSSDs) and e2 to customer mix and pricing. The limitations correctly say three suppliers' figures were not verified. Excerpts, dates and relations match the frozen items. The outcome is unresolved and the axis is causal, as both reviews agreed.

The Nebius–Meta agreement (16 March 2026, $12B of dedicated capacity) falls inside the Q1 2026 target period and meets the contradiction condition. The rationale correctly separates the absence claim from the narrower claim that investment is unjustified. The limitations say the demand is contracted, with delivery not yet made. The e2 date of 2025-12-31 is the balance-sheet date, so it does precede the target period. The excerpts are accurate.

Both pauses were driven by safety or security and were limited to certain workloads. OpenAI resumed on 1 October after 11 days, and Anthropic says most RL has resumed. The criteria keep 'entirely', and the open horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. The excerpts, dates (available 23 October and 31 August) and context relations are all correct.
